area.eligibility: Children under 12 ride free and must ride with a COTA//Plus account holder 12 or older.
area.tripRules: Rides are only provided within the designated service zones.
area.bookingInfo: Book in the COTA//Plus app or by phone at 614-308-4400. COTA//Plus accepts only credit or debit cards.

Grove City.hoursNote: The page says standard operating hours do not include weekends except for occasional special events service. Holiday service is not stated.

Westerville.serviceHours: Monday-Wednesday: 5:30 a.m.-8 p.m. (the same page also says Monday-Friday: 5:30 a.m.-8 p.m.)
Westerville.hoursNote: The COTA//Plus page gives both Monday-Wednesday and Monday-Friday for Westerville, so weekday service is left unset until confirmed. The page says standard operating hours do not include weekends except for occasional special events service. Holiday service is not stated.

South Side.serviceHours: Seven Days a Week, 5:30 a.m.-8 p.m.
South Side.hoursNote: One version of the South Side block on the page still carries the general line that standard hours do not include weekends; the South Side hours themselves say seven days a week. Holiday service is not stated.

notes: Zones from COTA's COTA_Plus_Zones layer (modified Apr 27, 2026); the older 2023 public view was not used. Each zone keeps the small detached parts the layer publishes: Grove City includes a pickup area at S High St near Obetz Rd (shown on the Nov 2025 South Side map as 'COTA//Plus Pickup to Grove City'), South Side includes the Franklin County Corrections Center area on Jackson Pike, and Westerville has two small detached parts. Westerville weekday hours conflict on the COTA//Plus page (Monday-Wednesday vs Monday-Friday); re-check and set Weekday once confirmed. Pickup method is left out because only Grove City is described as door-to-door.
